citations.assessment: Rambam names Yoḥanan son of Yeshua, son of Akiva’s father-in-law, where the latter phrase qualifies Yoḥanan. The digital Mishnah reads Yehoshua instead of Yeshua. The different father-in-law in Nedarim is a distinct report, not resolved here.

holds.reason: The bare Yehoshua heading lists a Yoḥanan ben Yehoshua but gives no kinship clue for that individual. Entry 1819 directly confirms this Yoḥanan ben Yeshua. The printed pointer’s intended referent remains qualified.
